text: The main shareholder of TransTeleCom (TTK) is OAO RZD (Russian Railways), which holds 99.99% of the company's shares.

source.quote: Основной акционер ТТК – ОАО «РЖД», владеет 99,99% акций Компании.
source.note: 'The main shareholder of TTK is OAO RZD, holding 99.99% of the company's shares.' Page has no publication date; opened 3 Oct 2026.
